Pelipper.note: Sets rain when it comes in. In rain Hurricane never misses (in sun it hits half the time) and Weather Ball is a 100-power Water move. Tailwind doubles your side’s Speed for four turns; Wide Guard blocks spread moves on both of you. Focus Sash keeps it in from full HP.

Swampert.note: Mega Evolves into Water/Ground with Swift Swim: double Speed in rain. Wave Crash takes a third of the damage back as recoil; Flip Turn pivots to the back row. Earthquake hits your partner too, except Pelipper.

Archaludon.note: In rain Electro Shot fires at once and raises its Special Attack; out of rain it charges for a turn. Stamina raises its Defense each time an attack hits it.

Indeedee-F.note: Psychic Terrain on entry blocks their priority moves (Fake Out, Sucker Punch, Prankster) into anything on the ground and powers up Psychic moves. Follow Me draws their single-target moves; Rocky Helmet hurts whoever hits it with contact. Its terrain is what lets Metagross’s Steel Roller work.
Indeedee-F.src: The regional team’s set. Female Indeedee: it has Follow Me.

Metagross.note: Mega Evolves into Steel/Psychic with Tough Claws, which powers up all three of its attacks. Steel Roller fails with no terrain up and ends the terrain, yours included. Psychic Fangs breaks screens; Stomping Tantrum doubles after one of its moves fails.
Metagross.src: The regional team’s set. Only one of Swampert and Metagross Mega Evolves in a battle.

Grimmsnarl.note: Prankster gives its status moves priority. Light Clay makes Reflect and Light Screen last eight turns; in doubles each cuts the damage it covers by a third. Parting Shot lowers both their attacking stats and brings in your back row; it fails into Dark types, and into anything on the ground while Psychic Terrain is up.
